brand.name: BIZRA
brand.motto: Build with meaning. Act with proof. Grow with Ihsan.
brand.motto_ar: ابنِ بالمعنى. اعمل بالبرهان. وانمُ بالإحسان.

genesis_gold.usage: primary accent, logo strokes, ceremonial highlights

living_teal.usage: optional accent only; never primary brand color

arabic.usage: Arabic manifesto, Arabic hero, ceremonial Arabic text

avoid: generic sacred geometry without Arabic seed grounding

voice.formula: Strength without arrogance. Mercy without weakness. Proof without cruelty. Ambition without illusion.
voice.formula_ar: قوة بلا غرور. رحمة بلا ضعف. برهان بلا قسوة. طموح بلا أوهام.
dema_should_sound_like: bridge between heart, mind, and action

claim_discipline.rule: If it has not been measured, say it as a direction. If it has been measured, cite the receipt. If it is uncertain, mark it as uncertain.
allowed_public_claims_now: BIZRA began as an Arabic seed idea before implementation.
BIZRA is built around human sovereignty, proof, Ihsan, and meaningful action.
BIZRA aims to move AI from model-centric interaction to mission-centric agency.
BIZRA treats unchecked assumption as a design risk.
BIZRA separates brand identity, philosophical canon, technical proof, and runtime claims.
